create_vjepa2_config: create a VJEPA2Config instance with default model configuration for video prediction
initialize_vjepa2_model: initialize a VJEPA2Model with a VJEPA2Config for pretrained video joint embedding
access_model_configuration: access the model configuration from a VJEPA2Model instance via the config attribute
customize_vjepa2_architecture: customize VJEPA2Config with custom hidden_size, num_hidden_layers, and num_attention_heads
configure_vjepa2_predictor: configure VJEPA2Config with custom pred_hidden_size, pred_num_hidden_layers, and pred_num_attention_heads for the predictor
